desc: L1 'O Davi nasceu com QI infinito' — tracking side shot: Davi sprints through the metro concourse; yellow ∞ + energy lines pop by his head on 'infinito'.

sfx.what: metro ambience + running footsteps (fast) + train PA chime

desc: L1 'Agora tá fugindo de' — low angle: Davi vaults a catraca (arm spins, LED red), whip in.

sfx.what: metal clank of turnstile arm + spin rattle

desc: L1 'agentes do governo num' — the 4 suits charge toward camera; HUD 'AGENTES 4'.
L1 'metrô. Spoiler: ele vai ganhar.' — wide chase on the platform (train behind); FREEZE-FRAME on 'Spoiler' (comic border, halftone); green stamp 'VAI GANHAR ✓' slams on 'ganhar'.
L2 'Porque ele sabe o que tu vai' — extreme close on Davi's eye; yellow energy lines + HUD iris rings.
L2 'fazer antes de tu saber.' — agents (slow-mo) with dotted prediction arrows + ghost outlines; HUD 'PREVISÃO'; on 'antes' they move into the ghosts.
L3 'Não é telepatia, é' — cartoon psychic waves over Davi's head, crossed out with a red ✗.
L3 'conta. Teu rosto' — yellow equations swirl around Davi's head (chalk-like).
L3 'tem quarenta e três músculos.' — face x-ray, 43 muscles light up with a counter; HUD '43 MÚSCULOS'.
L3 'Pensou, mexeu,' — agent bust: thought spark, then the mouth corner twitches.
L3 'por um vigésimo de segundo.' — film strip of the face; 1 frame circled; HUD '1/20 s' stopwatch.
L3 'Microexpressão.' — tight close on the twitch, circled; label 'MICROEXPRESSÃO'.
L3 'Existe de verdade.' — science card: 'MICROEXPRESSÃO (real)' + '1/25 – 1/5 s', green stamp 'REAL'.
L4 'O Davi vê todas.' — Davi in the metro crowd, tiny reading tags pop on every face.
L4 'Professor Xavier,' — generic homage silhouette: bald professor in a wheelchair, giant wired helmet, dramatic backlight.
L4 'dos X-Men?' — push into the helmet: wires spark, he strains, sweat drop.
L4 'Amador.' — Davi strolls past the helmet guy with nothing on his head; red stamp 'AMADOR'.
L4 'Precisa de capacete.' — Davi shrugs, taps his bare head; helmet behind fizzles with smoke.
L5 'Com cinco anos, sabia' — flashback: living room at Christmas, kid Davi (5); chip 'FLASHBACK · 5 ANOS'.
L5 'quando a mãe mentia.' — mom in a Santa hat kneels, smiling; kid squints suspiciously.
L5 'Papai Noel existe?' — two-shot, mom's smile freezes, sweat drop slides.
L5 'Noventa e quatro por cento' — close on mom: ReadTag 'MENTIRA 94%' counts up.
L5 'mentira.' — kid deadpan, arms crossed; mom's Santa hat droops behind.
L6 'Com dez, ganhava todo' — truco table, kid Davi (10) fans 4 glowing manilhas; chip '10 ANOS'.
L6 'truco da família.' — kid slaps the cards; the uncles throw their cards up in rage.
L6 'Nunca mais chamaram ele pro churrasco.' — barbecue party; pan to the gate sign 'PROIBIDO DAVI', kid outside.

sfx.what: grill sizzle + pagode in the distance

desc: L7 'Com dezoito,' — casino table, adult Davi with a tower of chips; chip '18 ANOS'.
L7 'banido de três' — two guards carry Davi by the arms, feet dangling.
L7 'cassinos no Paraguai.' — tossed out under 3 neon casinos; stamps 'BANIDO ×3' count 1-2-3.
L8 'O problema:' — Davi close, smile drops, warning icon.
L8 'ler gente esquenta o cérebro.' — x-ray head, brain glowing hotter, heat shimmer.
L8 'Uma pessoa,' — Davi reads one person (ReadTag), '1 PESSOA'.
L8 'trinta e sete e meio.' — big thermometer readout '37,5°' (warm orange brain).
L8 'Uma multidão,' — a wall of faces, dozens of tags pop at once; screen turns red.
L8 'passa de quarenta.' — Davi's head steaming, red tint + shake; '40°+'.
L8 'Guarda isso.' — quick punch-in on Davi winking, sparkle.
